text:
Aisha (Product): Ok planning sync — proposal for 'elastic reservations' model. TL;DR: customers buy a reserved baseline and get a credit pool for bursts (use-case: spiky traffic). Need validation criteria for beta.
Tom (Eng): love the idea. q: how do we handle preemption? are burst jobs best-effort?
Aisha (Product): yes best-effort. propose preemption window: bursts can be evicted when baseline usage > 95% for 2m. also return 503 + Retry-After for evicted requests.
Priya (ML): impact on latency p50/p95? if bursts are queued latency spikes. we should simulate with realistic token distributions.
Marco (SRE): agree. SLO proposal: Dedicated baseline 99.9% availability; bursts explicitly not SLA-backed. add alert if 'burst_eviction_rate' > 1%/day for a customer.
Jules (Sales): customers are asking for clearer billing examples. need sample calc: how credits map to token usage and invoice line items.
Aisha (Product): rough economics: 1 credit = 1k tokens; credits priced ~50% of on-demand per-token to encourage commits. open to feedback from sales/finance.
Tom (Eng): implementation sketch:
```
policy = {
  "baseline_qps": 10,
  "credit_pool": 100000,
  "replenish_rate_per_min": 2000,
  "preempt_threshold_pct": 95,
  "eviction_window_sec": 120
}
```
Will need runtime hooks: per-customer pool check, route to burst lanes, and eviction logic.
Priya (ML): also think about KV cache isolation across lanes. if we share nodes, cache thrash could spike p95. propose per-customer KV namespaces or short TTLs for burst traffic.
Marco (SRE): per-customer namespaces is safer; extra memory but much lower flakiness. we should test partial-region failure: what happens if a region loses a subset of nodes mid-burst.
Aisha (Product): beta launch criteria (proposal):
- internal load test reproducing 10x burst with credit exhaustion
- billing demo + sample invoice + pricing FAQ
- guardrails: automatic rollback to baseline-only routing on high-eviction signals
- runbook and oncall playbook for evictions and customer escalations
Tom (Eng): surface metrics in Console: credits_consumed_rate, time_to_replenish, credits_remaining_percent per customer/route. product needs per-route dashboard and alerting.
Aisha (Product): yes — add console widgets and an alert: credits < 10% => notify customer and sales.
Jules (Sales): need standard contract language: 'burst credits are best-effort, not SLA-backed'. legal to review. also want a short FAQ to reduce support tickets.
Aisha (Product): will ping Legal once we have final wording.
Marco (SRE): proposed canary plan: roll beta to 5 Dedicated customers across regions, monitor evictions, latency, infra cost delta. include automated rollback.
Priya (ML): simulation plan: synthetic prompts with heavy tail token distribution; run with cache hit/miss scenarios and measure token latency, end-to-end tail, and failure modes when credits exhausted.
Tom (Eng): action items (owners + rough ETA):
- @Tom (Eng): prototype runtime checks + per-customer pool (2w)
- @Priya (ML): simulation harness + latency matrix (1w)
- @Marco (SRE): canary runbook + alerts (1w)
- @Jules (Sales): sample pricing + contract language draft (1w)
- @Aisha (Product): beta customer list + launch criteria doc (end of sprint)
Aisha (Product): I'll spin up a PR in docs and link infra design. Anything else?
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: branch/elastic-reservations -> staging at 2024-05-08T02:00Z :rocket:
Tom (Eng): noted. I'll pick up infra changes after staging deploy.
Marco (SRE): add chaos test: node evictions during burst window to validate rollback and routing behavior.
Aisha (Product): thanks all. Meeting to review results next Tue 9am PT. :calendar:
